title: Find out why thirteen scripted walks are failing on main
goal: The scripted walks are the app's own rehearsal: each one drives the real editor through a flow a person would follow, and a red one means either that flow is broken or the walk has gone stale. Thirteen of the two hundred and seventy are red right now, and nobody knows which of the two it is. Work out which, fix the flows that are genuinely broken, and update the walks that are only out of date.
notes:
Reproduced on 2026-09-07 with the working tree stashed, so this is clean main and not the border work: built the probe from a clean checkout and ran each walk with Scripts/playtest.sh <walk> --no-build. Thirteen failed identically before and after the border change, which is how they were told apart from the one real regression (appearance-list-walk, fixed in that commit).

clip-contents / out-of-view-mark / size-limits: step press: the control "Limits" is not where a person could click it: it is off the window, or the dock has scrolled it far enough that the panel edge cuts across the point a press would land on.
contents-for-several: same, for "Stack".
dock-picked-first: step 47 waitFor: sectionInView("Text") did not happen within 4.0s.
colour-off-the-shelf / colour-onto-the-library: step dragColor: "Library" stayed dark for the colour off "Fill", and the walk expected it to take.
colour-onto-an-off-part: step 23 dragColor: no colour swatch for "Shadow" is in the panel; the ones that are: Fill.
parts-off-is-remembered / parts-settings-inline / switch-says-mixed: step press: no control called "Switch" in "Shadow" is in the panel; the ones that are: none.
component-whole-path: step 167 expect: the control called "Apply to Other Versions" reads "Shadow, there is something to carry", not "there is something to carry".
tool-tips: step 13 hover: no control with a tooltip starting "Inspector".

The three Shadow ones and colour-onto-an-off-part look like the same cause: the Shadow row left Appearance for the Effects list on 2026-09-07 and those walks still look for it in Appearance. The four dock-reach ones look like one cause too: the dock scrolls further than it did, so a row a walk presses is under its edge. Neither is confirmed.
acceptance: Each of the thirteen named walks is either passing again or has a task of its own saying what is broken in the app
Scripts/playtest-all.sh reports zero failures, or every remaining failure is listed with the task that owns it
Any walk that was only out of date is updated in place rather than deleted

log.note: Reproduced on a clean probe build of main: 12 of the 13 fail, component-whole-path-walk now passes (fixed by c830cf0c). Four separate causes, each confirmed by running the walk, not by reading code. (1) DOCK REACH, 4 walks (clip-contents, out-of-view-mark, size-limits, contents-for-several): the dock genuinely grew an Effects and a Component section, so Layout sits below the fold and a press on Limits/Stack is refused. Walk is stale. (2) SHADOW MOVED, 4 walks (parts-settings-inline, parts-off-is-remembered, switch-says-mixed, colour-onto-an-off-part): 9a165d31 moved Shadow out of Appearance into the Effects list, so there is no Switch or swatch in Shadow until an effect is added. Walk is stale. (3) HARNESS BUG, 2 walks (colour-off-the-shelf, colour-onto-the-library): PlaytestPanelDrag.destination picks the SMALLEST drop view under the point, and four overlapping drop areas sit over the Library. It picked a 264x263 one instead of the Library's own 264x299 one, so the Library's delegate was never asked at all (instrumented and confirmed: validateDrop never ran). App is fine, harness is wrong. (4) REAL APP REGRESSION, dock-picked-first: picking a Text layer leaves the Text section at 602-778 in a 688pt viewport. The 2026-09-07 migration that moved Appearance and Effects directly under Layers undid the 2026-09-06 decision that the picked thing's section is on screen without scrolling.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW before touching anything. The tempting fix for the four dock-reach failures was to bump the hand-tuned scroll numbers, and two of those walks were already carrying a -260 that had been tuned once and had quietly stopped being far enough. A number is a measurement of a dock that has since grown, so bumping it buys one more week. Nobody scrolls by 260 points either; they scroll until they can see the thing. So the walks now say the thing, with a new `reveal` step. The danger that comes with it is the opposite one: a `reveal` in front of a press hides a dock that got genuinely worse. That is exactly what dock-picked-first is, so it is left red and owned by a task rather than revealed, and the harness doc now says to read a walk's own claim before adding one.

SHIPPED. 12 of the 13 pass; the 13th is a real app regression with a task of its own. Two harness fixes and one new step: (a) PlaytestPanelDrag.destination now prefers the drop area whose frame matches the marker the walk NAMED, since SwiftUI lays drop areas out as flat siblings and four of them cover the Library; (b) an effect's colour swatch can be named by the effect ("Shadow") the way panelMenu already reads `in`; (c) a `reveal` step scrolls until a named control is pressable, with tests in PhotonzCoreTests and a doc section. Five walks updated for the app as it is now. Scripts/test.sh green (4795 tests). The twelve pass twice in a row, and a full Scripts/playtest-all.sh run is 279 passed with only dock-picked-first and region-keeps-your-layer failing, both owned by filed tasks (nine others in that sweep were machine-load flakes that all pass cleanly on their own; noted so nobody chases them). No audit written: nothing user-facing landed, so there is nothing for a person to try in the app.

12 of the 13 walks pass again (twice in a row, and inside a full 279-passing playtest-all sweep). Two harness bugs fixed: the drop area a walk names is now the one asked (was picking the smallest of four stacked over the Library), and an effect's colour swatch can be named by the effect. New reveal step scrolls until a control is pressable, replacing hand-tuned scroll distances that go stale every time the dock grows; tested in PhotonzCoreTests and documented. Five walks updated in place for the Appearance/Effects split and the Hide Panel tooltip. The 13th, dock-picked-first, is a real regression and is owned by picking-a-text-layer-leaves-its-settings-below-the-fold; region-keeps-your-layer turned up in the sweep and is owned by undo-does-not-bring-back-pictures-deleted-with-a-marquee-band. Committed 87b3141a.
